subject: Feature request: bulk export to CSV
body_html:
Hi,

We love the product! One feature request: could you add a bulk export to CSV for the analytics dashboard? We have ~5,000 records to export monthly and doing it row by row is painful.

Happy to jump on a call to discuss.

Mia (ClientCo)
